default/31043.htm.text: Melody Maestro Octavia: I am a magician of melody! I put music into crystals for your listning pleasure! Tra La La~! What sound would you like me to put into a crystal~? It only costs 200 adena, a very reasonable price!

links.text: [Create an Echo Crystal - Theme of Solitude]
[Create an Echo Crystal - Theme of the Feast]

Q00432_BirthdayPartySong/31043-01.htm.text: Melody Maestro Octavia: This beautiful weather has inspired me to finish a birthday musical piece, but I need some Red Crystals to store it! Will you help me find some?

Q00432_BirthdayPartySong/31043-00.htm.text: Melody Maestro Octavia: You need more classical training to be of help here! (This quest can only be undertaken by a character of level 31 or above.)

Q00432_BirthdayPartySong/31043-03.html.text: Melody Maestro Octavia: Don't give up! For a hero like you, this should be easy! Go in again, and bring back the crystal...

Q00432_BirthdayPartySong/31043-04.html.text: Melody Maestro Octavia: Isn't this wonderful? Now I can share my birthday song with everyone! Yahoo!! Aren't you also happy?

Q00432_BirthdayPartySong/31043-02.htm.text: Melody Maestro Octavia: Kill rough hewn rock golems in the Floran Agricultural Area to get the Red Crystals. Come back when you have 50!

Q00432_BirthdayPartySong/31043-05.html.text: Melody Maestro Octavia: Here's a small gift for the help. Now you can play birthday music for all your friends!

Q00432_BirthdayPartySong/31043-06.html.text: Melody Maestro Octavia: If there is no crystal... There is no music... If you don't even know that... I wonder... How you can call yourself an adventurer... And travel around this world ...

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-01.htm.text: Octavia: Music and travel are my two favorite things! Music makes travel twice as exciting! Your crystal is finished! Tra la la~!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-02.htm.text: Octavia: I'm trying to make a living here! If you won't pay for the ingredients, who do you think will? An Echo Crystal will cost you 200 adena.

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-03.htm.text: Octavia: How do you expect me to make an Echo Crystal without a score? Unless you want a silent Echo Crystal~!! Bard Swan has a lovely travel score you might like... Tra la la~ la la~!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-04.htm.text: Octavia: Oh, my! What a bellicose theme! I feel like marching off to war! Da dum da dum dum~! La la~! Your crystal is finished~! Tra la la~ la la~!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-05.htm.text: Octavia: I'm trying to make a living here! If you won't pay for the ingredients, who do you think will? An Echo Crystal will cost you 200 adena.

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-06.htm.text: Octavia: How can I make an Echo Crystal without a score~? Unless you want me to make a silent Echo Crystal~!!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-07.htm.text: Octavia: What is the taste of love? Is it sweet like honey or bitter like black beer? I'll bet it tastes like a Dion potato! Yum! Your crystal is finished! I hope you enjoy it!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-08.htm.text: Octavia: I'm trying to make a living here! If you won't pay for the ingredients, do you expect me to? An Echo Crystal will cost you 200 adena.

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-09.htm.text: Octavia: How do you expect me to make an Echo Crystal without a score? Unless you want a silent Echo Crystal~!!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-10.htm.text: Octavia: Oh, the lonely moon! My aching heart! This isn't my style at all!~ Your crystal is finished!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-11.htm.text: Octavia: I'm trying to make a living here! If you won't pay for the ingredients, do you expect me to? An Echo Crystal will cost you 200 adena.

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-12.htm.text: Octavia: How do you expect me to make an Echo Crystal without a score? Unless you a silent Echo Crystal!! A fellow once told me that an excellent theme of solitude can be obtained from Musician Nanarin. He has quite a fondness for beards. Tra la la la la!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-13.htm.text: Octavia: Shake that booty! Yeah, baby! Go! Dance, you slug! You self-centered buffoon! Shake your body! Feel the beat! Your crystal is finished!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-14.htm.text: Octavia: I'm trying to make a living here! If you won't pay for the ingredients, who do you think will? An Echo Crystal will cost you 200 adena.

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-15.htm.text: Octavia: How do you expect me to make an Echo Crystal without a score? Unless you want a silent Echo Crystal!! Barbado has a lovely score with a theme of feast!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-16.htm.text: Octavia: Come out and play with me! Forget your troubles! Come on! Get happy! It's finished! This is really my kind of music!

ai/npc/EchoCrystals/31043-17.htm.text: Octavia: Ah, what a touching melody! Such heart-felt sentiments. And just think, it was made especially for you! Enjoy!
